changelog: Behavioral Review Engine: daily/weekly/monthly/quarterly/yearly, per-challenge & combined
20+ deterministic behavior rules: revenge-trade detection, risk creep, overtrading, tilt, emotion-outcome correlation, session leaks, setup-grade validity, variable attribution, drawdown proximity
Every insight states its sample size and flags early signals vs conclusive patterns
Replaces manual Weekly Review with automatic AI-style nudges (deterministic PHP, no external API calls)
New ai_reviews table stores each generated review; old ReviewController/weekly_reviews left untouched

db_migrations.name: create_ai_reviews_table
db_migrations.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ai_reviews (id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, user_id INT NOT NULL, challenge_id INT DEFAULT NULL, period_type ENUM('daily','weekly','monthly','quarterly','yearly') NOT NULL, period_start DATE NOT NULL, period_end DATE NOT NULL, insights_json MEDIUMTEXT, metrics_json MEDIUMTEXT, created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, KEY idx_user_period (user_id, period_type, period_start)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_general_ci
